title: The Gujarat Assembly, Before and After 2008
name: Gujarat
intro: For three decades, Gujarat was fought on the 182 constituencies of the 1976 delimitation order. The 2008 order redrew all of them.
The assembly map Gujarat retired in 2008

map_caveats: In dense urban seats (Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara), drawn boundaries follow the source shapefile and may differ slightly from the exact ward extent in the delimitation orders.

In Ahmedabad city the source shapefile places the old 1976 seats wrongly, so the drawn 1976 map is unreliable there. The links for every old and new Ahmedabad city seat were rebuilt by hand in November 2026, after a reader's note, from the ward and village lists in the two Orders and checked against where sitting members moved in 2012; the map shapes were not redrawn, and percentage shares are not given for these seats.
